scope: Bounded completed-evidence/source read for why lazyKD need not beat ranked scans. No live30s outcomes were read and no target/helper/profile work was run.
supported_explanation: The default is already a filtered dense scan: rank_bucketed_vector_backed keeps contiguous Vector objects and a separate contiguous nondecreasing rank array. contains_impl lower-bounds the query's coordinate-sum rank and compares only that suffix, stopping at a witness. This is not a flat slab of all coordinates and not an unfiltered all-pairs baseline. The optimized default also reuses valid cached ranks and avoids some unnecessary equal-rank retirement comparisons.

Retained lazyKD checks live pending IDs first, then walks a frozen bucket tree. Coordinate0 catalogs and sampled internal bridges accelerate locating leaf ranges; split geometry can prune subtrees, but surviving candidates still require full partial_order confirmation. Stable-ID/live lookups, catalogs/traversal, pending scans and threshold-triggered replacement index construction are real source work. Their individual cycle/cache cost is not established by source inspection.

The completed RR captured CPre (4588 generators,453 coordinates) has10149479 whole-operation wrapper partial-order attempts for oldlazy versus5376016 for oldrank789 and5273875 for newrank30e, in either width. These include the CPre subphases, not only membership-query comparisons, and a full-order attempt may short-circuit rather than inspect all453 coordinates. It is a measured example of more exact order work, not a universal high-dimensional failure theorem.

The same RR CPre software pass sums81163 allocation requests/38480535 requested bytes for oldlazy versus78056/36518464 for either ranked control. These are instrumented phase sums, not a summed transient heap peak or clean clock. The profile's explicit lazy rebuild is distinct from clean replay's metric named rebuild, which means a second fresh construction.

The rejected two-column filter's RR miss is narrower evidence: all4067 frozen candidates survived those selected columns, plus521 pending comparisons, giving4588 full-order attempts. Pending is actually searched first. Zero selected-column rejection does not mean all KD geometry/catalog pruning is ineffective: the saved fullarb miss excludes every frozen candidate by geometry/coordinate0 and pays1023 pending comparisons before explicit rebuild, then zero afterward.

Completed clean RR CPre endpoint medians are lazy180.500268ms/137.109857ms and optimizedrank98.552219ms/77.895543ms for compatible16/native64 signed-char lanes. These endpoints come from different completed source-comparison reports and schedules; they are useful corroborating examples, not a newly matched cross-backend ratio or a whole-solver prediction. Collector's captured predecessor has523 coordinates, demonstrating that these are large-coordinate workloads rather than generic2D/3D spatial lookups.
whole_solver_limit: The accepted final17 campaign has identical1368/1524 solved cases and only6.4888813456s totalPAR2 advantage for frozen lazyFC (about0.1091%), with one attempt per case and unknown noise floor. NO_VERBOSE provides no runtime fraction in the chosen downset route. The solver also performs translation/automata/native portfolio work. Common or bypassed work can dilute a container difference, but its fraction and causal contribution were not profiled. Near-identical solver totals therefore do not prove equal downset cost, nor establish a lazyKD speedup. The comparison is actual e167-original versus frozencc lazyFC whole configurations, not an isolated-header treatment.
